sentence: 減った客足取り戻さなきゃいけないし、
literal: I've got to win back the customers I've lost, and...
official: Now I'm scrambling to get new customers to make up for all the ones I lost.

sentence: なるほど……　わかった。助かったよ。
literal: I see... Understood. You've been a big help.
official: All right, thanks. I appreciate it.

sentence: ほかのホームレス仲間はどうしたんだ？
literal: What happened to the rest of your homeless buddies?
official: Hey. Where'd all your other buddies go?

sentence: もうここでの仕事は済んだってさ、
literal: They said their work here was already done, so...
official: They told us this one's all done.

sentence: 立華さんとこは手広くやってるから。
literal: 'Cause Tachibana's outfit runs a wide operation.
official: Tachibana-san's got his fingers in all sortsa pies.

sentence: あの人たちは、神室町の“闇”だよ。
literal: Those people are the “darkness” of Kamurocho.
official: They're the very shadows of this town.

sentence: 相手がヤクザだろうが弱み見つけ出して
literal: Even if they're up against a yakuza, they'll dig up his weak spot—
official: Whoever ya are, yakuza, doesn't matter. They know yer secrets.

sentence: すぐに金玉握っちまう。
literal: —and have him by the balls in no time.
official: Have ya by the balls before ya can blink.
